name: Johannes Michael Tauscher
title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer – Industrial AI & Scientific Software
tagline: Building mathematically grounded software that turns data, models, and optimization into measurable improvements in real-world systems.
bio: Hi! My name is Johannes. I'm an applied machine learning engineer and technical generalist focused on mathematically demanding software for real-world systems.
I enjoy working end-to-end: from framing the right question and exploring data to implementing algorithms, evaluating models, and shipping reliable systems.
I'm especially interested in problems where data, models, and algorithms create transparent and measurable improvements.
I prefer Linux-first environments and open-source tools. For me, AI is an engineering tool, not an end in itself.

One of my many interests is the AI revolution: {{llm}}s, the surrounding software, and the infrastructure that makes intelligence scale. Not only witnessing but helping shape these developments drives me every day!
Knowledge is one of the most exciting and important things out there to me. I find the potential of AI to democratize knowledge and lower access barriers for everyone genuinely inspiring.
I balance screen time with hands-on work (e.g., catering gigs), teach myself piano and Japanese for fun, and give pro bono stats tutoring because knowledge should be shared.

I'm looking for roles where I can combine machine learning, mathematics, and software engineering to improve physical, industrial, or scientific systems. If that sounds like your team, feel free to reach out!
cvSummary: Applied Machine Learning Engineer and Data Scientist grounded in statistics, optimization, and software engineering. Builds reliable ML and data systems end-to-end for industrial, physical, and scientific applications.
